simulation: Actual production stepMatch loop. One setup initializes the existing layup-reverse shot state on a one-player diagnostic match. Candidate track and optional made-shot release Vz are injected into the served animation module in-page only; no production files changed.
grid: Post-release trajectory checkpoints plus score/dead-ball completion for both facings × 100%/120%
captureMethod: For each facing, the match starts with Kraken on the selected offensive roster (home for right, away for left) so the production renderer resolves him from the matching team roster. A one-time diagnostic fixture keeps only that real Kraken player in frame and initializes the production layup-reverse shot action. Production stepMatch advances animation, takeoff, carried-ball track, release, shot physics, rim/score resolution, and completion continuously. No manual per-tick ball teleporting; no pause overlay; no ball baked into art.
fixture: Fresh match per facing/zoom; after 100 neutral production ticks with Kraken holding the ball at the attacking rim, the camera follows normally and the action begins. The production stepMatch path runs until score/ball completion.
setupFixture: Per facing, Jam Stage starts a real roster containing Kraken on the scoring team (home for right, away for left). After fixture setup and 100 neutral production ticks, the harness seeds the renderer camera to the athlete/target-rim framing (right=155, left=45) through the Jam Stage camera state. It disables only autonomous loop startup; every controlled window.jamverse.tick advances production stepMatch and calls render(), so the stage camera continues tracking the simulated ball. The fixture initializes layup-reverse at the existing two-point distance; no simulation coordinates are changed after launch.
